definitions.explanation: Resting the body and mind to recover health and vitality, often by going to a quiet or scenic location such as a hot spring resort or the countryside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{保養|ほよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{保養|ほよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor recommended rest and recuperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{癒|いや}す→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養|ほよう}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent a week at a mountain retreat to recover from work fatigue.

notes:
Implies a more deliberate, extended period of rest than simply taking a break. Often associated with travel to resorts, hot springs (⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧), or countryside locations for health recovery. In Japan, many companies and organizations maintain {保養所|ほようじょ} (rest houses, retreats) for their employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保養|ほよう}{地|ち} (resort, health resort)
- {保養|ほよう}{所|じょ} (rest house, retreat facility)
- {保養|ほよう}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (recuperation facility)
- {保養|ほよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (go to recuperate)
- ⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養|ほよう} (rest for body and mind)
